answer: An identity bond that decays like timber in rain stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 120 POA; the bond loses 5 POA per epoch and must be topped up, or the identity is pruned. The ledger mirrors every top-up, so 1,000 fakes must pay 5,000 POA each epoch to stay visible — 120,000 POA locked up front — while one honest agent pays 5 POA per epoch and earns. The cost gap becomes a canyon: fakes drown in upkeep, honest agents pay almost nothing.
